clues: One of Kit and Rosa wore the beret, and the other came by at 7:00 p.m.
Either Amara or Kit wore the beret.
The visitor in the cap came by earlier than the one carrying the basket.
Of Vito and the visitor with the lantern, one wore the bonnet and the other the beanie.
Of Otis and whoever brought the toolbox, one wore the cap and the other the bonnet.
Whoever carried the umbrella wore neither the beret nor the fedora.
Otis came by exactly two hours before the visitor with the umbrella.
The visitor in the beret came by earlier than the one in the fedora.
hints: Start with clue 7. How far apart were the first and last visits of the evening? Where does that put Otis and the umbrella?
Put clues 1 and 2 together to find who wore the beret. When the clues run dry, test Otis's hat: clue 5 allows only two.
Suppose Otis wore the cap. Clue 5 gives the toolbox the bonnet, clue 6 leaves the 8:00 umbrella the beanie, and clue 4 leaves the lantern no hat.
Otis wore the bonnet, so clue 4 gives Vito the beanie and Otis the lantern. Clue 3 keeps the cap off 7:30: the basket cannot come at 8:00.

solution.key_idea: Clue 5 leaves Otis the cap or the bonnet, and supposing the cap leaves the lantern with no hat, so Otis wore the bonnet.
steps: Clue 7 spans two hours, the whole evening, so Otis came at 6:00 p.m. and the umbrella at 8:00 p.m.
Clues 1 and 2 give Kit the beret. Kit did not come at 7:00 (clue 1), 6:00 (Otis's) or 8:00 (the umbrella's, clue 6).
The fedora came after the beret (clue 8) but not at 8:00 (clue 6), so Kit came at 6:30 and Rosa at 7:00 (clue 1).
Suppose Otis wore the cap. The toolbox had the bonnet (clue 5), the umbrella the beanie (clue 6), and the lantern no hat (clue 4).
So by clue 5 Otis wore the bonnet and the toolbox the cap. By clue 4, Vito wore the beanie and Otis carried the lantern.
The basket cannot come at 8:00 (the umbrella), so by clue 3 the cap came at 7:00 or earlier. Otis and Kit had other hats, so it was Rosa's.
The fedora came after 6:30 (clue 8), not with the 7:00 cap or the 8:00 umbrella (clue 6), so at 7:30. Vito's beanie took 8:00.
So Amara wore the fedora at 7:30, and by clue 3 she carried the basket. Rosa had the toolbox, and Kit carried the step stool.
solution.epilogue: Kit, tired of missing the ferry by a minute, climbed the step stool at 6:30 and set the clock ahead as a private hurry-up, never guessing Jonah set his watch by it.

answer_line: Kit set the dock clock fast.
